(Aardvark Labs, 2026-10-30)

(That NAV Guy, 2026-10-30)

The tool allows recording and replaying user actions in the web client to create repeatable user acceptance tests without writing code. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-29)

Partner early access started October 27, 2026 on partner sandboxes running 30.0.56564.0 or later, with public preview planned for April 2027. It also covers Business Skills, the Expense Agent and what AI interaction means for AL page design. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-28)
- [Business Central 29: What’s New in BC-Bench?](thinkaboutit-be/8331.md): BC-Bench is Microsoft's open-source framework for evaluating AI coding agents on Business Central AL development tasks like bug fixing, test generation, and code review. It helps measure whether AI models and tools actually improve AL development performance compared to general coding benchmarks. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-28)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: An error occurred when communicating with Dataverse (User does not have required privileges to access the org when it is in Admin Only mode)](yzhums-com/76990.md): When integrating Business Central with Dataverse, users may encounter an error stating they lack required privileges in Admin Only mode. The issue originates in the Power Platform environment, not Business Central. Disabling Administration mode in the Power Platform admin center and reconfiguring the Dataverse integration resolves the problem. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-28)
- [Business Central 29: Manage Per-Tenant Extensions from the Admin Center](thinkaboutit-be/8313.md): Business Central 29 moves Per-Tenant Extension (PTE) management to the Admin Center, allowing administrators to upload, install, update, schedule, and monitor PTE deployments centrally. The existing Extension Management experience will be deprecated starting with Business Central 30 in April 2027. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-27)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: The AL Table Proxy Generator is distributed in the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package (altpgen.exe missing from AL Language extension)](yzhums-com/76918.md): The AL Table Proxy Generator tool (altpgen.exe) is now distributed through the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package instead of the AL Language extension, with support for .NET versions 8.0 and 10.0. The tool generates proxy tables for integrating Microsoft Dataverse tables into Business Central. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-26)

These changes reduce repetitive work when building Word layouts and provide a more structured approach to report development. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-26)

- [Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Evolve AL interfaces with default implementations (Default interface method implementations)](yzhums-com/76547.md): Default interface method implementations in BC29 allow interfaces to include method bodies so existing implementors can omit them and inherit default behavior or override them. This feature, requiring runtime 18.0 or later, lets extension publishers add behavior without forcing immediate changes to implementing extensions, with RequiredPending and AppSourceCop rules supporting a managed transition path. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-26)

- [Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): New “Recent Record” virtual table (2000000174)](yzhums-com/76509.md): Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces the "Recent Record" virtual table (2000000174) that tracks records most recently accessed by the current user within the current company. This read-only table supports deletion but not insert or modify operations, and developers can now retrieve recent records directly from AL code. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-23)

- [Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Cancelling a scheduled PTE update install (Next Major/Next Minor) in admin center](yzhums-com/76546.md): In BC29, a PTE install scheduled from the Business Central admin center (Next Minor or Next Major) can be cancelled using Manage updates and then Cancel scheduled install. Before this, the only option was to re-upload the same version to overwrite the schedule. Cancelling removes that version from the service, and the Operations page then shows the status as Canceled along with the user who cancelled it. (Dynamics 365 Lab - Yun Zhu, 2026-10-20)

- [Securing your Azure Storage Account: a guide to enabling Business Central-only access using Network Security Perimeter (part2) – now with Service Tags.](demiliani-com/17492.md): Azure Network Security Perimeter gained public preview support, announced October 6, 2026, for service tags as the source of inbound access rules. Administrators can restrict an Azure Storage Account to Business Central traffic by choosing the Dynamics365BusinessCentral service tag instead of maintaining IP lists, while Microsoft keeps the ranges current. Tags are broad, so this means trusting the service as a whole. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-10-13)

- [Business Central 29: How Many Fields Can a Table Really Have?](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-6265805346314332006--6288317504.md): Business Central 29 stores table-extension fields in the same database table as the base table instead of separate companion tables, making SQL column limits more relevant. The post investigates the practical field limit for tables, which Microsoft documents as 500 fields with an 8,060-byte record size, and explains how the new compiler warning helps developers detect tables approaching SQL extensibility limits. - [Dynamics 365 Business Central: locking down IsolatedStorage reads.](demiliani-com/15914.md): Starting with runtime version 18.0, the IsolatedStorage.Get method accepts an optional IsolationLevel parameter to prevent race conditions during concurrent read-modify-write operations. The new UpdLock isolation level holds an update lock on a key's row during reads, blocking other sessions until the transaction completes, protecting sensitive data like secret keys, feature flags, and cached tokens from concurrent corruption. - [The price of running Fkh (Freddy’s Kubernetes Helper)](freddysblog/https-freddysblog-com-2026-08-05-the-pricing-of-fkh--e248e34869.md): Fkh runs in your own Azure subscription. This post lists every cost component, explains how each one scales with concurrent containers and Windows node size, and gives example monthly bills. With an 8-hour working day and scale-to-zero, cost per container falls to roughly $30 to $60 at 10 to 40 containers. Running 24/7 costs several times more, so StopFkh, spot nodes and right-sizing matter. (Freddys blog, 2026-08-05)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: AL transaction isolation levels and cache usage.](demiliani-com/14031.md): Runtime version 11 added Record.ReadIsolation, which overrides a transaction's isolation level for reads on one record instance. The NST record cache only answers Get() calls under Default or ReadUncommitted. ReadCommitted, RepeatableRead and UpdLock send every Get() to SQL Server, which can slow repeated reads a lot. The author argues that RepeatableRead and UpdLock could safely use the cache once the lock is held. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-08-05)

- [API Pages vs API Queries in Business Central: When to Use Each](thinkaboutit-be/7683.md): API pages and API queries are two distinct REST API object types in Business Central with different purposes. API pages support full CRUD operations and are best for write operations, while API queries are optimized for read-only access with multi-table joins and server-side aggregation. Understanding when to use each type is critical for performance and integration design. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-03-17)

- [Rec.Truncate in AL](duiliotacconi-com/1850.md): Rec.Truncate is a new AL method based on SQL Server TRUNCATE TABLE that empties a table in milliseconds rather than deleting row by row. If a constraint is hit (system or virtual table, try function, security filters, delete event subscribers, Media fields, many marked rows, FlowField filters) it falls back to slow DeleteAll behavior. With filters it saves rows to keep and restores them, which only pays off when removing about 50-60% or more. (Duilio Tacconi, 2026-02-10)

- [DataTransfer type causing runtime errors](nataliekarolak-com/3910.md): The DataTransfer type speeds up AL upgrade code, but two cases fail at runtime with no compiler warning: AddConstantValue with literal values on Code fields, later fixed in platform builds 27.0.44405 and 26.0.44406, and AddSourceFilter on FlowFields, FlowFilters or Media fields. - [LockTimeoutDuration in AL](duiliotacconi-com/1717.md): Starting with Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (v27), AL code can call Database.LockTimeoutDuration to raise or lower the lock timeout for a specific statement, overriding the global value (30 seconds online, 10 seconds in a v27 on-premises demo database). Setting it to 0 is capped by the platform at 1,710,000 ms (28.5 minutes). The author advises using it only for critical procedures, since low values cause more timeout errors and high values risk blocking chains and deadlocks. (Duilio Tacconi, 2025-12-10)

- [When Auditing meets Telemetry: a practical example.](duiliotacconi-com/1601.md): A real case where Default Dimension records disappeared. Change Log showed the user and the time, but telemetry traces and page views showed that the user had unknowingly triggered the deletion by running a calculation action. A temporary-record check placed too late in the code caused real dimension data to be deleted. The fix was to move that check to the first line of the OnAfterDeleteEvent. (Duilio Tacconi, 2025-09-05)

The post explains how to write clear, actionable error messages that guide users to solutions rather than leaving them frustrated, with practical examples showing vague messages transformed into helpful ones. (That NAV Guy, 2025-04-14)
- [Dynamics GP to Business Central – How to Recreate the GL Summary Enquiry using G/L Account Balance, Analysis Mode or an Analysis View](thedynamicsexplorer-com/8821.md): When migrating from Dynamics GP to Business Central, GL account structures change from segmented codes to single codes with dimensions. The post explains three methods to recreate Dynamics GP's GL Summary Enquiry view in Business Central: filtering the Chart of Accounts page, using Analysis Mode with natural language in Copilot, or creating an Analysis View. (The Dynamics Explorer, 2025-04-11)

(Gerardo Renteria, 2025-04-11)
- [BC Friday Tips #27 Replace Blank Values using Transformation Rules](thatnavguy-com/https-thatnavguy-com-blog-2025-bc-friday-tips-27-replace-blank-values-using-transformation-rules--bc0a2627b6.md): Transformation Rules can replace blank values in Business Central using regular expressions. Set the transformation type to "Replace" and use the pattern ^$ to match empty strings without requiring any development. (That NAV Guy, 2025-04-11)
- [An MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central? Why not?](demiliani-com/11666.md): Explains the Model Context Protocol, an open standard from Anthropic for connecting AI apps to tools and data, and contrasts it with function calling. The author argues MCP suits Business Central and demos an alpha Admin Center MCP server that lists installed AppSource apps, checks for updates and schedules them from GitHub Copilot agent mode or Cursor. (Stefano Demiliani, 2025-04-09)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 1 release: the state of SOAP deprecation.](demiliani-com/11654.md): Starting with Business Central 2025 Wave 1 (version 26), exposing Microsoft UI pages as SOAP endpoints is off by default. It can be turned back on with a Feature Management key, and it will be removed for good in version 29. Custom pages exposed as SOAP still work but should move to OData. Exposing Microsoft UI pages as OData now gives warnings and stops being possible in version 30, so custom OData pages should move to APIs. (Stefano Demiliani, 2025-04-07)
